title: Vite project anatomy
summary: We create a React project with Vite on your computer and follow how index.html, main.jsx, and App.jsx hand the page to each other. You will write a first component in its own file and build the project into the dist folder that a server can host.
changeNote: Rewritten so each step opens with an explainer or a prediction, folds the background under Read more, and ends with a quiz.
